ezra: deploy-bot triggered autorevert for release v4.1.0 — p95 latency spike on gen-route in ap-south-1 :warning:
deploy-bot: AUTOREVERT triggered for release v4.1.0 at 2026-01-14T03:12:57Z. Reason: latency_p95_aps > 650ms for 3 windows. Rolling back to v4.0.9.
ezra: hmm we changed a telemetry allocation path last minute. Could be inducing GC on warmup.
maya: @sre-ops any infra events? we had a scheduled canary at 03:10 UTC.
sre-ops: checking... no infra incidents. I see first-request tail in traces and kvcache coldstart at 03:11. Snippet: `03:11:05 host=worker-3 p95=710ms kvcache_hit=0.11`
ezra: proposal: hold the autorevert, pin canary slice, run 3 quick synthetics. If p95 stays high -> let revert. If stabilizes -> hotpatch to raise prefill and disable telemetry alloc.
maya: +1. Who can flip manual hold? cmd: `deploybot override hold <release>`
sre-ops: executing hold: `deploybot override hold v4.1.0 --by=sre-ops --reason="investigating warmup"`
oncall-bot: Action recorded: deploybot override hold v4.1.0 by sre-ops at 2026-01-14T03:14:12Z
maya: running synthetics: run1 p95=700ms run2 p95=320ms run3 p95=310ms. pattern = warmup.
ezra: ok keep hold. maya open hotpatch PR `hotpatch/telemetry-heapcap-2026-01-14` and run two more runs post-merge.
maya: PR opened; CI green. merged sha=9a1b2c. running verification: run1 p95=305ms run2 p95=298ms. kvcache_hit=0.79.
ezra: good. unhold and rollforward after 2 successful synthetics. s re-ops can you unhold? cmd: `deploybot override release v4.1.0 --action=unhold --by=sre-ops`
sre-ops: executing unhold. Action logged at 2026-01-14T03:25:50Z
maya: rollforward in progress. monitoring 30m. if anything flares we revert and we'll send the prepared customer note.
